truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 identified 10 vulnerabilities, accurately capturing format-string injection, hardcoded credentials, two buffer overflows, two command injections, authentication bypass, race condition, division by zero, and use-after-free. It missed 10 true vulnerabilities (integer overflow, path traversal, weak PRNG, thread-unsafe timestamp cache, insecure temp files, persistent auth state, unhandled exceptions, integer underflow, unbounded recursion, and data race). Several findings contained CWE classification overclaims that required correction.

Items.Notes: Run 2 explicitly identified the runtime log format string flaw with matching evidence and CWE-134.
Run 2 did not identify the integer overflow in the factorial computation loop.
